disposition: Excluded qualification attempts. Their zero or repeated counts are not evidence of parcel absence or completeness. No raw response geometry or nonpublic attributes are included.

runs.reason: EPSG:2236 conversion used an incorrect latitude of origin. All 13 cell counts were zero; this was a projection error, not parcel absence.
False easting was entered in feet while proj4 expects the equivalent value in metres. Projected point fell outside the published layer extent; repeated cell counts are invalid evidence.
Projection was corrected, but the scratch descriptor capped queryBounds at 1 km² and stopped footprint binding. The final run used a bounded 25 km² cap and passed.

privacy: Only test names, safe request counts/statuses, grid feature counts and failure explanations are retained. No raw response bodies, feature properties or geometries are included.
